title: [29.X]-ZUGFeRD: Custom Ship-to Address is not transferred to XML Delivery Address in the German version.
summary: Backport to 29.x: a custom ship-to address on a document is now carried into the XML delivery address in ZUGFeRD exports for Germany, and the XRechnung export is also changed. PEPPOL30 sales validation, the W1 and NO PEPPOL30 invoice and credit memo XMLports, and related tests are modified too.
key_points: Fixes custom ship-to address not reaching the XML delivery address in ZUGFeRD
Export XRechnung Document codeunit also modified
PEPPOL30 Impl., PEPPOL30 sales validation, and the W1 and NO PEPPOL30 invoice and credit memo XMLports are changed
Tests added for ZUGFeRD, XRechnung, E-Document DE and PEPPOL30 management
